topics.name: 1 Hardware
points: CPU: Von Neumann architecture and components (control unit, ALU, registers, cache, main memory)
The fetch-decode-execute cycle
CPU performance: cache, clock speed and number of cores
Primary storage: RAM, ROM, flash, cache and virtual memory
Additional hardware components: integrated and dedicated GPUs, sound cards, motherboards
Secondary storage: optical, magnetic, solid state and cloud; suitability by capacity, durability, portability, speed, cost
Embedded systems: characteristics, purpose and example uses

topics.name: 2 Logical operations
points: Logical operators AND, OR, NOT and XOR: truth tables and problem solving
Simplifying Boolean expressions

topics.name: 3 Networking and cybersecurity
points: Networks: characteristics, advantages and disadvantages
Network topologies: star, mesh, ring and bus
Network hardware: routers, hubs, switches, bridges, wireless access points and NICs
Networking standards and the layers of the OSI model
Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, FTP, TCP, IP, Ethernet and WiFi
TCP/IP packets, packet switching, routing and routing costs
The internet: DNS servers, URL structure and web browsers
Cybersecurity threats: malware, phishing, social engineering, brute force, denial of service, data interception, SQL injection
Protection: penetration testing, network forensics, anti-malware, firewalls, access levels, passwords, double authentication, encryption

topics.name: 4 Data representation and storage
points: Data types: integer, real, character, string and Boolean
Converting between denary, binary and hexadecimal
Two's complement and sign and magnitude
Binary addition and subtraction; overflow and underflow; arithmetic shifts
Representation of characters: ASCII and Unicode
Representation of graphics: resolution, colour depth and storage calculations
Representation of sound: sampling rate and storage calculations
Storage units from bit and nibble to petabyte; capacity calculations
Compression: lossy and lossless; compression ratios

topics.name: 5 Data organisation
points: Data structures: records, one-dimensional and two-dimensional arrays; selecting appropriate structures
File design: files and records for a given application

topics.name: 6 Operating systems
points: Purpose of operating systems: managing the CPU, multi-tasking and interrupts
Operating system management of memory, backing store, peripherals, interface and security
Utility software: anti-virus, backup, disk checkers, defragmenters, formatters, compression and other utilities

topics.name: 7 Principles of programming
points: Levels of computer language: high-level and low-level languages and when each is appropriate

topics.name: 8 Algorithms and constructs
points: Representing algorithms with pseudo-code and flowcharts
Writing, correcting, testing and interpreting algorithms: sequence, selection, iteration, counts and rogue values
Subroutines, local and global variables, self-documenting identifiers
String handling, mathematical and logical operations in algorithms
Sorting algorithms: merge sort and bubble sort
Searching algorithms: linear search and binary search
Validation and verification: purpose, techniques and algorithms

topics.name: 9 Software development
points: Software tools in an IDE: editor, formatting, line numbering, colour coding, statement completion
Linkers, loaders, libraries and standard functions
Debugging tools: error diagnostics, trace, break points, variable watch, memory inspector; code optimisation

topics.name: 10 Program construction
points: Translators: compilers, interpreters and assemblers, and their appropriate use
Stages of compilation: lexical, syntax and semantic analysis, code generation and optimisation
Programming errors: logical, syntax, run-time, linking, rounding and truncation

topics.name: 11 Impacts of digital technology on wider society
points: Ethical, legal, cultural, environmental and privacy impacts of digital technology
Legislation: GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018, Computer Misuse Act 1990
Legislation: Copyright Designs and Patents Act 1988 and Creative Commons licensing
Legislation: Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000, Telecommunications Regulations 2000, Freedom of Information Act 2000
Professional standards: formal and informal codes of ethical behaviour and conduct

topics.name: Systems analysis and programming
points: Investigation: systematic problem solving, decomposition and abstraction, analysing requirements
Design: inputs, outputs and user interface, data structures, pseudo-code for validation and verification, authentication
Implementation: data types and constructs (sequence, selection, iteration) in Python 3
Implementation: functions, subroutines, objects and libraries
Implementation: string manipulation, lists, tuples, dictionaries and slicing
Implementation: file handling
Implementation: graphical user interfaces (text boxes, buttons, forms)
Implementation: validation and authentication routines; self-documenting code, consistent style and annotation
Testing: strategies and test plans; typical, extreme and erroneous test data; test commentaries
Refinement: responding to revised requirements, improving efficiency, evaluating given code
